CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE "library_reserve_matrl_detail" AS SELECT "library_course_instructor_key" AS "library_course_instructor_key", "library_reserve_catalog_key" AS "library_reserve_catalog_key", "library_material_status_key" AS "library_material_status_key", "term_code" AS "term_code", "subject_id" AS "subject_id" FROM _probe_reserve_matrl_detail;
CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE "_probe_course_instructor" AS SELECT library_course_instructor_key, course_name FROM beaver."LIBRARY_COURSE_INSTRUCTOR"
CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE "library_course_instructor" AS SELECT "library_course_instructor_key" AS "library_course_instructor_key", "course_name" AS "course_name" FROM _probe_course_instructor;
CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE "_probe_material_status" AS SELECT library_material_status_key, library_material_status FROM beaver."LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS"

CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE "library_material_status" AS SELECT "library_material_status_key" AS "library_material_status_key", "library_material_status" AS "library_material_status" FROM _probe_material_status;
CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE "_probe_reserve_catalog" AS SELECT library_reserve_catalog_key, catalog_year FROM beaver."LIBRARY_RESERVE_CATALOG"
CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE "library_reserve_catalog" AS SELECT "library_reserve_catalog_key" AS "library_reserve_catalog_key", "catalog_year" AS "catalog_year" FROM _probe_reserve_catalog;

CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE conductor_s_execution AS
WITH joined AS (
  SELECT 
    lci.course_name,
    lrc.catalog_year,
    lms.library_material_status
  FROM library_reserve_matrl_detail lrd
  LEFT JOIN library_course_instructor lci
    ON lrd.library_course_instructor_key = lci.library_course_instructor_key
  LEFT JOIN library_reserve_catalog lrc
    ON lrd.library_reserve_catalog_key = lrc.library_reserve_catalog_key
  LEFT JOIN library_material_status lms
    ON lrd.library_material_status_key = lms.library_material_status_key
)
SELECT 
  course_name,
  COUNT(*) AS total_materials,
  MIN(catalog_year) AS min_publication_year,
  MAX(catalog_year) AS max_publication_year,
  COUNT(DISTINCT library_material_status) AS total_distinct_material_statuses
FROM joined
GROUP BY course_name
ORDER BY course_name
LIMIT 200
